scope: INITIAL coherent core slice only: ordered stack/duplicates/Routeidentity, unmounted Request capture/views, normal/route-skip/repeated/postresponse/joinedcross-thread Next, initial pending return and late publication. Not full mounts/hooks/methods/errors/Deferred/resource/shutdown or Java/Kotlin overloads.

failure_modes: new grammar rejected by old registration
red_evidence.verification: Inspected actual log and committed tests; did not run tests again against intentionally unchanged RED implementation.

findings.problem: Test calls app.freeze while lifecycle remains NEW; it never listens or enters RUNNING. An implementation that allows additions after freeze but keeps the old state!=NEW registration ban could pass, contradicting explicitly scoped after-listen behavior.
findings.new_test_needed: Use existing in-memory/test adapter to actually listen and verify RUNNING, register a new route and attach a handler to a pre-created RouteBuilder, issue requests through that running app, and assert both succeed. Keep server/config-only mutation such as jsonLimit rejected and shutdown the app in finally. A direct app.freeze test may remain as a separate case.

findings.problem: Actual app tests cover independent scalar/list values but not duplicate-name scalar/wildcard winners. Foundation matcher tests cover Match.wildcards, yet a Request integration that derives shape from static declaration metadata rather than the actual participating winner could still pass all initial app tests.
findings.new_test_needed: Dispatch /:x{/*x} with /one and /one/two, then /*x/:x with /one/two/three. Assert pathParams.x is respectively String one, List[two], String three; assert paramValues/paramOrNull documented behavior and optional nonparticipant does not overwrite an earlier participating value.

findings.problem: All view assertions use a query-free RecordingExchange whose rawQuery always returns null. A new url/originalUrl accessor implemented as pathname-only would pass. Basic unmounted query preservation is independent of the expressly deferred mount stage.
findings.new_test_needed: Send unmounted raw target /x/a%2Fb?q=%252F&v=1 (using existing in-memory adapter or suitable SPI exchange) and assert path/rawPath remain pathname-only while url and originalUrl include exact raw query; also distinguish rawQuery=null from rawQuery="" so a trailing question mark is retained. Mount restoration can stay deferred.
